scientific_integrity.exact_domain: All nonempty finite directed multiquivers, including loops and parallel arrows, and every finite field F_q, for the radical-square-zero algebra F_q Q/J^2 with right evaluation of coefficients-on-left polynomials
limitations: Finite checker only covers listed prime fields and small quivers
Priority remains subject to inspection of additional unpublished or unindexed literature
scientific_integrity.main_claim: Exact componentwise null ideal, right-polynomial function count q^{q(v+r+m)}, bijective right-polynomial function count (q!)^v(q-1)^{qr}q^{qm}, and composition closure exactly for loop-only quivers
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Unique-radical-factor path-power formula; divided differences and Hermite interpolation modulo (X^q-X)^2; fiberwise affine bijection criterion; explicit composition obstruction

title: Right-polynomial maps on every finite radical-square-zero quiver algebra
